result:
The build passes with `ns build ios`. Changes made for Phase 3 (Transcribe):

- **`app/services/speech.ts`** — new service wrapping `SFSpeechRecognizer`/`SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest` for authorization state and file-based transcription with partial results, mirroring the `healthkit.ts` pattern.
- **`app/components/Transcribe.vue`** — wired to the service: status line reflects authorization (refreshed on each navigation), `Transcribe Sample` enabled only when granted and not running, live partial updates, and a `Completed in N.N s` line on success; errors surface in the status line.
- **`app/assets/sample.wav`** — copy of `spec-assets/sample.wav` placed where `@nativescript/vite` bundles static assets (verified it lands at `nsbenchmark.app/app/assets/sample.wav`, matching `knownFolders.currentApp().path`), so it ships in the bundle without touching the read-only `spec-assets/` dir.
- **`Info.plist`** — added `NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription`.

`spec-assets/` and `SPEC.md` were left untouched; sections 3 and 4 were not modified.
